name: Santa Amalia (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green with the white stripe twice the width of the others, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa Amalia (a rose, a church and waves).
history: The flag is rectangular, composed of three horizontal stripes, red, white and green, the central stripe twice the width of the other two, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Santa Amalia arms — rose, church and waves
